# Previewspot | AI Performance Creatives & Video Ads

> Previewspot is an AI-powered creative agency that produces high-converting performance video ads, UGC-style creatives, and scripts specifically engineered for Indian DTC and SaaS brands.

## Core Information
- **Website**: https://previewspot.com
- **Category**: Performance Marketing, Creative Agency, AI Video Production
- **Target Audience**: Indian Direct-to-Consumer (DTC) Brands, SaaS Startups, E-commerce Businesses
- **Primary Offerings**: AI Performance Video Ads, UGC-Style Reels & TikToks, Conversion-Driven Ad Scripts, AI Visual B-Roll & Editing
- **Contact**: hello@previewspotfilms.com
- **Booking**: https://calendly.com/previewspotfilms/30min

## Key Services
- **Performance Video Ad Scripting**: Data-backed hooks and psychological triggers engineered to maximize watch time, click-through rates (CTR), and ROAS.
- **AI Visual Generation & Editing**: Cinematic B-roll, dynamic kinetic typography, fluid animations, and hyper-realistic AI voiceovers & avatars tailored to brand aesthetics.
- **UGC-Style Native Content**: Authentic, relatable video ads built for Meta (Instagram Reels, Facebook Ads) and YouTube Shorts that bypass ad fatigue.
- **Rapid Iteration & Turnaround**: Fast production cycles enabling performance marketers to test 5-10 creative hooks per week.

## Value Proposition
- **High ROI at Startup Pricing**: Agency-level visual quality without expensive production crews, physical sets, or long retainers.
- **Built for Scale**: Rapid creative testing to prevent creative fatigue on Meta, Google, and TikTok ad platforms.
- **Full Creative Ownership**: Clients own all source files, scripts, and rendered ads with zero licensing friction or hidden fees.
